start.intro: In the morning open “My tasks”: each row is one job for your role. The bell tells you about news, search (Ctrl K) finds a letter, request, client or invoice by number.

director.title: Director
steps: Open “My tasks”: letters without a resolution, quotes for approval and memos are waiting for you.
Incoming letters: put a resolution — choose the assignees and the costing deadline.
Quotes for approval: check the margin and sign-offs, approve or send back.
Memos: approve, return or reject; a reason is required for rejection.
Projects and the company summary: see what is stuck.

manager.title: Manager
steps: “Awaiting reply”: bot handovers and client messages — answer or take into work.
Create a request from a lead: the client and the number ЗВ-YYYY-NNN appear.
Follow the request step on its card: resolution, costing, quote.
Need to buy something for work — file a memo.

supply.title: Supply
steps: “My tasks”: costing tasks arrive after the director's resolution.
Select items: stock, suppliers, delivery terms.
Give the “goods and stock” sign-off. When all sign-offs are in, the quote goes to the director.

engineer.title: Chief engineer
steps: “My tasks”: service tasks arrive after the director's resolution.
Cost the services: terms of reference, crew, deadlines.
Give the “services” sign-off. When all sign-offs are in, the quote goes to the director.

accountant.title: Accountant
steps: “My tasks”: payment orders to confirm and invoices to issue.
Confirm payment against the statement: the invoice closes in full or in part.
Contracts and acts: record issuing and signing, attach the scan.
Overdue invoices also arrive as tasks.

admin.title: Administrator
steps: “Settings”: roles, employees, connections and the journal.
For a new employee: “Invite employee” and assign a role.
“Needs attention” in connections: what is broken and who is fixing it.
“Staff requests”: answer your colleagues' questions.

default.title: Any role
steps: “My tasks” are jobs for your role. One row is one action.
Search (Ctrl K) and the bell help you not to lose anything.
Something is missing — “Write to the administrator”.

path.intro: A request goes through seven steps, the same for everyone. The current step is always shown in the card header; every step has one owner and one main button.

steps.title: Request
steps.text: The manager creates a request from a lead: text, lines, the client's letter. The letter is registered with an ВХ number.

steps.title: Resolution
steps.text: The director puts a resolution: decision, assignees, costing deadline. Or returns it to the manager, or rejects it.

steps.title: Costing
steps.text: Specialists cost prices, stock and services and give sign-offs. When all sign-offs are in, the costing is ready.

steps.title: Quote
steps.text: The director approves the quote; the client receives it through their channel and accepts or declines it.

steps.title: Contract
steps.text: The client agrees the wording, the contract is issued and signed with the operator outside the Platform; the scan is attached by hand.

steps.title: Payment
steps.text: The invoice is issued, the client attaches the payment order, the accountant confirms payment against the statement. Delivery runs in parallel.

steps.title: Completed
steps.text: The act is signed, all invoices are paid — the request is closed.

path.lost: On steps 2–5 a request can be closed with a reason — “Lost”; it can be restored at the “Costing” step.

glossary.intro: These words are the same across the whole interface.

items.text: A person or company that wrote for the first time; not a client yet.
A company with contacts. Appears when the manager creates a request from a lead.
A client's need: text, lines, attachments, a letter. Goes through seven steps.
The same request after the client accepted the quote; inherits the request number.
An official client document addressed to the director; waits for a resolution.
The director's decision on an incoming letter: text, assignees, deadline, margin limit.
Request lines with stock and supplier data and specialists' sign-offs.
A commercial offer with versions. Goes to the client only after the director approves.
The outgoing number a quote gets on approval.
A draft contract from the accepted quote; signed with the operator, the scan is attached.
An invoice for payment: prepayment, balance or stage.
The client's payment order (a file) that the accountant confirms.
An act of completed work or delivery; the signed scan is attached.
An internal employee document addressed to the director: subject, text, amount or deadline.
Your question to the administrator: access, notifications, template, error. Not to be confused with a client's appeal on a project.

keys.intro: Hotkeys do not work while the cursor is in an input field.

Open help for the current screen.
Close a window: help, notifications, the “Where to look” hint.
Move to the next and previous element; Enter presses a button or opens a link.

news.intro: What has changed in the Platform.

items.title: Help, first login and requests to the administrator
items.text: The “?” button opens help for the current screen; “Write to the administrator” works from the “No access” screen and from Help; replies arrive in the bell and in Telegram.

items.title: Honest placeholders and a queue without dead ends
items.text: A section that is not in the Platform yet says where the work is done now; in “My tasks” the “Open” button becomes “Where to do it” if there is no screen yet.

items.title: Profile
items.text: Photo, phone, signature, Telegram and deputy during vacation are on the profile page.

articles.intro: Articles by Platform section. The “?” button in the header leads to the right one.

write.title: Write to the administrator
write.lead: Describe what happened. The administrator will reply in the Platform and in Telegram.
write.subject: Subject
write.bodyPlaceholder: For example: I need access to “Costing” to see the supply tasks
consequence: The administrator gets the request in “Settings · Staff requests” and in Telegram.
The page and your role are attached automatically.
The reply arrives in the bell and in Telegram if linked; the status is in “My requests”.
write.doneText: The administrator will reply in the bell and in Telegram. The status is in “My requests”.
write.bodyTooLong: The text is longer than 4000 characters: shorten it

card.hint: Open a request from the list — its text, page, replies and the “Reply” button appear here.
card.notFoundText: The number is wrong or the request was removed.
card.subject: Subject
card.replyPlaceholder: What was done or what needs clarifying
consequence: The author gets the reply in the bell and in Telegram if linked.
A new request is taken “In progress” after a reply.
The status and the reply are written to the journal.

card.readOnly: The director reads requests; the administrator replies and changes the status.

welcome.title: Welcome, {{name}}
welcome.lead: Here is what you will be doing in the morning:

rail.title: Modules
rail.text: On the left (at the bottom on a phone) are only the modules your role allows. The rest are hidden, and a section you cannot open says so itself.

menu.title: “My tasks”
menu.text: The first item of Home is what to do now. One row is one job; the “Open” button leads to it.

bell.title: The bell
bell.text: Decisions, client messages and the administrator's replies. If Telegram is linked they arrive there too.

help.title: Help
help.text: The “?” button opens the article for the current screen. From there you can write to the administrator.
